entities.name: Claimify
entities.description: An LLM-based method that identifies sentences containing factual claims and decomposes them into simple, self-contained claims.

entities.name: Metropolitansky and Larson
entities.description: Authors associated with the Claimify method.

entities.name: Ni et al. (2024)
entities.description: A publication providing the definition of a factual claim used in the experiment.

entities.name: Comprehensiveness
entities.description: A metric measured as the average number of claims extracted from generated answers.

entities.name: Diversity
entities.description: A metric measured by clustering claims and calculating the average number of clusters.

entities.name: Padmakumar and He (2024)
entities.description: A publication describing the clustering approach used for the Diversity metric.

entities.name: Pedregosa et al., 2011
entities.description: A publication associated with the Scikit-learn implementation of agglomerative clustering.

entities.name: ROUGE-L
entities.description: A distance metric component used in the clustering process (1 - ROUGE-L).

relationships.description: Claimify is attributed to Metropolitansky and Larson (2025).
The Comprehensiveness metric relies on the claims extracted by Claimify.
The Diversity metric relies on the claims extracted by Claimify.
The Diversity metric uses 1 - ROUGE-L as a distance measure for clustering.
